statement: Won 15 piggy pets from a dart minigame; they give auto loot, infinite teleport and storage access from anywhere.
Hoop/hole was reworked: no longer gives candy but gives buffs like damage percent and money percent; strongly suggests doing it.
New dart minigame and the rework can give a trophy; both are strong and give damage and talent points.
These give damage; talent points; movement speed; money percent; and reduced vault cost.
Do the new hole and dart minigames on cooldown on top of Poppy and owl.
Viewer suggestion he validates: use the click on doggy from vault instead of typing 'if you love me let me go'.
A green stack is a world 4 mechanic: a 10 million stack of a unique item in storage gives a damage percent source.
Viewers suggest saving elemental sorcerer for green stacking quest items; he suggests skipping that suggestion thanks to world 7.
Elemental sorcerer is best for farming quests in early to mid game; you will want to do that eventually for damage percent.
Green stacking is only a little damage percent and with world 7 gains you can finish it quickly with time candy on another character.
First quest line needs cherries; monicles and snelby sharp shells; it gives five keys; the second quest line gives a key a day and is skipped for now.
The kangaroo mouse bonus for bluefish was great.
Before starting Ephont he bought needed shop items such as storage inventory slots since he had extra cash.
He tends to neglect owl so he gave it some attention to avoid falling behind.
Chose between leveling hemoglobin or Amarok to unlock the last helmet piece; decided to unlock the helmet.
World 3 mechanic: buying 2,000 gems unlocks armor set passives; full Amarok set gives 40% accuracy and 40% defense for that character.
Suggests getting at least one full Amarok set for your pushing character for the bonus.
Gus was at mimics for sigils ready to push to hunter subclass; shaman farmed birch; Una farmed copper ore.
Pushing through world 2 to reach fruit flies for the alchemy bubble FMJ for defense.
Unlocked some vials and new bubbles; not yet at Shakers or FMJ.
Has little armor yet; in hindsight he would have worked on it sooner.
Put Una on iron to farm bars for Amarok gear; important.
Anvil tab tier 2 and iron boots require iron bars; copper from the previous day was plentiful so iron is the focus.
Used saved cash to unlock upgrade tab up to beholder statue for the account-wide bonus; skipped bullseye as unaffordable and it comes from walking sticks.
Plinko gives chance at gold balls spent in the arcade shop; wait for the rotation which increases golden ball values before spending.
Stamps reducing plinko cost are horribly rare; 0.1% chance on a golden bucket; some long-time players have one.
Cosmic balls only come from events so don't worry about them.
Focused Uruar for respawn; before elite classes hunter was best by a margin thanks to that respawn ability.
Ludy McShooty: collect a unique item on any character once for extra damage per 50 items.
He drops items on the ground and picks them up to count; lava apparently fixed that; he lost event items to Ludy.
Hunter build: Uruar for triple shot; Ludy McShooty for damage percent; bear trap for active farming; skipped 360 no scope.
Archer talents and first tab are the same as other archers.
Golden food is not consumed and gives bonuses; golden jam increases max health 0.93%; more you have the stronger.
Golden food is the endgame of consumables and has later effect bonuses.
Always check your production constantly.
Barbarian farming iron; shaman moved to jungle trees due to many bleach logs overnight.
Gus pushing crab cakes; Mafioso on way to fruit flies; hunter pushing levels since world 3 not reached.
Crafted a copper chopper and copper pickaxe; cheaper than expected.
Armor smithy needs buying at least 2000 gems or waiting 30 days for free-to-play; need full set including helmet.
Copper set bonus is 60% mining and choppin efficiency; strong but free-to-play must wait.
Farmed Amarok to get the last piece of helmet.
Did the merit task on all characters though probably won't use it since walking sticks untouched.
Spike minigame once a day at top of the hour; gems depend on spikes dodged per round; round seven gave about 13 gems.
Current focus is Amarok gear and finishing anvil tab 2.
Finished last three items axe; quarter staff; burst longbow to unlock desert Dave and the new task board.
Usually prefers unlocking star talent book chances.
Other preferences: gems from bosses; monsters dropping oles; rest into mob respawn to boost damage.
Bought a ton of bribes with lots of value; check stuff to not go overboard.
Leveled all stamps; got value from shield stamp; also accuracy; mana; HP; damage stamps.
Got another HP stamp and an accuracy stamp dropped from mobs.
Leveled chopping and mining stamps to about 65; worth it even if underleveled for diminishing bonuses; helps task board.
Pushing squire to about 260-280 MP to run sword slash whirl; bricky skin and firmly grasp at once for mana regen.
Most people run active and leave it overnight; when fighting mobs active is usually better; when AFK skilling is usually better.
Get used to active farming since statues; crystal farming and some master classes require only active farming.
Ephont has six arms and an immortal head with 100000 health doing 10 damage until arms are destroyed.
Top right arm and finger pistol are one-shot mechanics; each destroyed arm speeds up others; kill top right first then finger pistol.
Cheese with barbarian axe roll or squire dagger rang since arm hitboxes do not move.
After all hands die the head takes maximum damage and shoots O's doing about 64 damage; defeat it.
World 3 has the densest mechanics in the game and is make or break for players.
Before anything in world 3 do the Hogan quest line; mechanics like 3D printer and shrine architect are locked until it.
Refinery is the biggest time gate; people talk of water locked (dense water) and salt locked (refinery).
Red salts use green mushroom spore caps and copper ore; bar fills to allow ranking up.
Never turn auto refine on for red salts or green salts; keep it off.
Keep refinery going; salts are overpowered in this game.
World 3 looks empty because you must build everything; table has buildings; towers for tower defense; and shrines placed on maps for bonuses.
Build the 3D printer first and max it as soon as you can.
Quest required 24 hours worth of red salts so he farmed green spore caps.
Rank increases salts per 15-minute rotation and output speed but also costs more materials.
Mid to late game only two characters sit on the cog board; the two squires provide about 99% of build rate; others build cogs.
Flaggies unlock more board space; costs get expensive after the first four.
Focus build rate now but eventually click the eyeball to always focus XP%.
Squire's refinery throttle talent skips refinery cycles; about 15 at level 100.
Used time candy on green mushroom spore caps to finish the 24-hour red salts quest; then refinery throttle for salts to buy 3D printer.
Buy a trapping box and a wax skull from the world 3 shop on every character; wax skull generates worship charge.
Next hogan quest requires trapping.
Hunter's Eagle-Eye opens trapping UI to collect remotely but only gets about 75% critters and 60% XP.
Building 3D printer gives star talent for sampling; one point gives 10%; check in construction skill tab.
Max printer sample rate is 90%; samples your overall AFK gains.
First print was green mushrooms to keep refinery afloat.
Save gems for the crystal 3D printer; unlocks two print slots per character; great value.
Lava changed trapping so all critters are unlocked from the start; quest line gives 10% per critter.
Frog quest is really good for time candy.
Needed smithing 21 for full Amarok gear; boosted smithing XP by crafting log bags from birch logs.
Pen pals minigame gives shiny critter chance; trapping XP; more critters and efficiency; almost free value.
Placed four traps at frogs and one at crabs with 20-minute traps; set a timer and collect via hunter eagle-eye.
Shiny quantities do not change by trap duration so a longer trap gains the same shinies as a 20-minute trap.
Sampling book is obtained by building the 3D printer and also from the quest line.
Wanted to unlock world 3 task board for another build slot.
Squire to frost flakes; shaman woodboards for gigafrog; barbarian iron ore; hunter sheepies; bowman sand castles toward fruit flies.
